An exponential feed sets mu through the negative feedback d(ln q_S)/dt = mu_set - mu(q_S), which has no fixed point once the strain cannot reach the setpoint: the culture grows at its own maximum and the carbon it cannot take up accumulates. There is no held steady state to report, and a reduced product rate here would describe a vessel filling with unconsumed substrate
